{{Quote|Where do those folks over there come from? And is it a group, or one person?''"<br />"''Why, a group, of course, sir. They are from the fourth world of Markbee's Star, specifically, from&mdash;if I am not mistaken&mdash;Zeffliffl.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="TCS" />}}
'''Zeffliffl''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], located on the [[Relgim Run/Legends|Relgim Run]]. It was home to the [[Zeffliffl (species)|Zeffliffl]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which evolved in [[salt water]] [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] in the planet's southern hemisphere. The Zeffliffl had established contact with the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] prior to [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].

==Description==
Zeffliffl was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Markbee's Star]],<ref name="TCS" /> located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="SWR" /> It lay on the [[Relgim Run/Legends|Relgim Run]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that branched off the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]]. Zeffliffl was bracketed on this hyperlane by the [[Generis system/Legends|Generis system]] coreward and the [[Nam'ta system/Legends|Nam'ta system]] rimward.<ref name="TEA" /> In the planet's southern hemisphere there was a small continent with [[salt water]] [[Ocean/Legends|seas]].<ref name="TCS" />

==History==
The planet Zeffliffl evolved [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] life within the shallow seas of a continent in its southern hemisphere. This [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Zeffliffl (species)|Zeffliffl]], resembled lumps of dark [[Color/Legends|green]] or blue-black [[Seaweed/Legends|seaweed]]. Groups of these individuals bonded together such that any outsiders who joined the group were rejected at a subconscious level, akin to an allergic reaction.<ref name="TCS" />

At some point prior to [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] discovered Zeffliffl, and some familiarity with its native species was not uncommon for [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] such as the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] model. In 14 ABY, a group of Zeffliffl traveled to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] research station-turned-bazaar known as [[Crseih Station]]. There, they presented an ill member of their species to the [[Waru]], an extra-galactic being, for healing.<ref name="TCS" />
